sentences.text:
The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973('Code', for short),
for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioner is apprehending arrest by Venjaramoodu Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram, in an unregistered crime alleging the petitioner to have committed the offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

3. Heard; Sri. M.T. Sureshkumar, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt. Nima T.V., the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents.
4.
The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that as on today there is no case registered against the petitioner by the said police, as alleged in the bail application.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is closed.

It is made clear that, if the presence of the petitioner is required by Venjaramoodu police with regard to the allegations made in the bail application, he shall be issued with a notice under Section 41A of the Code, if the offence alleged against him is punishable for a period less than seven years.

Sd/-
 C.S.DIAS,JUDGE DST/16.01.24 //True copy//
